title_zh: 约好先确认市属花园清理许可

scenario.label_zh: 约好先确认市属花园清理许可
scenario.goal_zh: 指出花园失于维护的情况，并约定先向市方确认志愿清理范围再组织人手

context_zh: 一位居民与社区非营利机构协调员商量清理市属花园。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: The municipal garden has weeds across the path and rubbish around the benches. It looks like months of neglect.

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Our non-profit group could help, but the garden belongs to the city. We need to ask what we’re allowed to do.

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: Could you mobilize volunteers once the city confirms the work?

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Yes. I can organize a small team, but I won’t invite anyone until we know the approved tasks and how the rubbish will be collected.

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: I’ll contact the parks office about both points and bring you their reply.

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Thanks. Then we can arrange a cleanup that fits their instructions.
